research_period: Milan, Paris and Pitti Uomo menswear shows, June 2026; Premiere Vision Paris, February 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Global: Milan, Paris and Florence runways; premium and mid-market menswear
title: SS27 Men's Trim Innovations
summary: Cooling and performance details move into menswear: fan-cooled garments, running-vest bottle holders and passport pockets, alongside chrome-free leather components.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- **Integrated cooling:** Rick Owens showed inflatable tracksuits with integrated fans using Adidas's Climacool heat-regulation technology<sup>[1]</sup>.
- **Performance details:** Y-3 showed a running vest with bottle holders<sup>[1]</sup>.
- **Travel details:** Herno added passport-sized pockets to crease-proof travel pieces<sup>[2]</sup>.
- **Chrome-free leather:** Margaret Howell's Dr Martens 1461 uses chrome-free leather by C.F. Stead, designed to patina<sup>[2]</sup>.

sections.heading: Readiness
sections.body:
| Innovation | Readiness (Forecut assessment) |
|---|---|
| Passport and utility pockets | Ready |
| Bottle and gear holders | Ready from sportswear suppliers |
| Chrome-free leather trims | Ready; check supply |
| Integrated fans | Experimental; showpieces only |

design_implications: - Add functional pockets to travel tailoring and outerwear.
commercial_implications: - Functional details justify full price on core pieces.

sources.title: Between heatwave and restraint: menswear trends from Paris
